items.t: Said the federal government has been heartless in how it treats people who came to the country to do better.
items.q: When we think of just the brutality of this federal government for almost two years, it’s been heartless. It’s been too silent on the other side of the aisle. They are treating people with no respect or dignity — people who came here to do better.

items.t: Said in a post on X that she was horrified by ICE agents' actions and use of deadly force.
items.q: Completely horrified by ICE agents so brutally hunting down, harming people every day – and now using deadly force!!!! God have mercy

items.t: Said the Pardon Board's unanimous vote requirement should be replaced with a three-fifths standard.
items.q: Replacing Pennsylvania’s burdensome unanimous vote requirement by the Pardon Board with the three-fifths standard that served our state well for most of its history

record.t: Was elected the 141st Speaker of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives and was reelected Speaker on January 7, 2025.
record.q: McClinton was elected the 141st Speaker of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on February 28, 2023 and reelected Speaker on January 7, 2025.

record.t: Was elected as the Democratic Leader of the Pennsylvania State House.
record.q: Representative Joanna McClinton, who has been elected as the Democratic Leader of the Pennsylvania State House.

record.t: Served as the first woman Democratic Caucus Chair from 2018 to 2020.
record.q: Before being the first woman elected Speaker, McClinton was the first woman to serve as Democratic Caucus Chair, 2018-2020

record.t: Won a special election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives and was sworn in on August 25, 2015.
record.q: McClinton won a special election to the House of Representatives on August 11, 2015, and was sworn in on August 25, 2015.

record.t: Proposed a constitutional amendment to update the commutations process.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Austin Davis today endorsed House Speaker Joanna McClinton’s constitutional amendment to update the commutations process.
